claim_scope: Source-defined dense FEDP arithmetic, separate four-thread WMMA application configuration and independent compact matrix-memory layout fixtures; execution results and phase acceptance require separate reviewed evidence.

profile.memory_scope: Direct packed FEDP inputs; local memory and matrix loaders are not exercised.
profile.geometry_scope: One output from four products plus C; separate from the actual P02 WMMA application geometry and historical P01 application profiles.
profile.role: Direct-input FEDP leaf diagnostic profile, separate from the WMMA application profile.

application_profile.name: p02-tfr

layout.dimensions: Positive M,N,K with M divisible by 8, N by 4 and K by 8; complete compact tiles only.

application_profile.matching_rule: Application and backend share the identical profile bytes and format-flag configuration identity; retain and compare actual resolved generated configuration and compiler records. No ambient feature override is in scope.

inherited_constraints.reason: The profile schema cannot pin false for this non-_ENABLE option. Defining it to zero enables #ifdef paths, so require the revision-bound false default and no override.

application_profile.fixture_input_adapter: pending; existing sgemm_tcu generates inputs and does not read the layout JSON

tfr_model.role: production software model consumer; not a full SimX processor execution

arithmetic.input_quantization: none; raw FP16/BF16 words and raw FP32 C are supplied
arithmetic.packing: lane i uses word i//2, bits 16*(i%2)+15 through 16*(i%2), paired A[i] with B[i]
arithmetic.common_quantum: 2^(max effective term exponent - 24), equivalently 2^(RTL maximum exponent - 284)
arithmetic.alignment: truncate each unsigned magnitude right shift, then apply sign; shift distances >=26 produce zero magnitude
arithmetic.accumulation: exact sum of four aligned signed products and aligned C in 30 bits
arithmetic.sticky: global OR of every nonzero discarded lane tail; tails retain no sign and do not cancel
arithmetic.final_rounding: nearest, ties to even, on retained normalized window plus global sticky
arithmetic.infinity: propagate unique infinite sign after NaN precedence
arithmetic.overflow: signed infinity when rounded biased exponent >=255
arithmetic.underflow: signed zero when rounded biased exponent <=0; no output subnormal encoding
arithmetic.input_subnormals: preserved during decode with exponent field replaced by 1 and no hidden bit; not renormalized before maximum-exponent selection
arithmetic.architectural_exception_flags: not specified or claimed by this contract

producer.method: independent integer and rational implementation of the specified fixed window

fixtures.freeze_requirement: Review final producer and artifact identities before acceptance evaluation; hashes were recorded only after producer bytes were available.

corpus_extension.prior_diagnostic_scope: Any retained 96-case leaf diagnostic remains scoped to its original corpus and tested revision; it does not establish execution of the added pair or the application layout cases.

producer.method: integer encodings and direct integer matrix multiplication

layout_fixtures.fixture_profile: Compact matrix memories and exact-integer products for the frozen four-thread WMMA geometry; initial C=0, KUNROLL=1, no padding, arbitrary strides or tails.

packing.input_order: Consecutive memory elements occupy low then high 16 bits of each word.
packing.a_words: Complete row-major M*K input memory; lda=K elements.
packing.b_words: Complete column-major K*N input memory; ldb=K elements.
packing.expected: Complete row-major M*N FP32 output bits; ldc=N elements.
packing.hex_encoding: Eight lowercase hexadecimal digits per 32-bit word, without a prefix.

coverage.boundaries: First/last rows and columns, adjacent packed halves, four-product groups, and M=8/N=4/K=8 tile boundaries.
coverage.cancellation: Nonzero first-half sums cancel across FEDP boundaries and, for K=16, across K tiles; even rows produce +0 and odd rows retain a nonzero residual.

exactness.input_values: Small integers exactly representable in both FP16 and BF16.
exactness.reason: Every product and prefix sum is integral and below 2^12 in magnitude; each four-product fixed-window quantum divides every term exactly, and FP32 represents each sum exactly.

layout_fixtures.fixture_input_adapter: pending; existing sgemm_tcu generates its inputs and does not read this JSON
layout_fixtures.execution_limits: The producer does not execute or validate vx_tensor.h gather/scatter, memory operations, SimX, RTL or GPU instructions. Existing sgemm_tcu does not consume these fixtures. Matrix-layout execution requires a separate adapter and reviewed source-bound application/backend evidence.
layout_fixtures.freeze_requirement: Review final layout artifact, producer and application profile bytes before acceptance evaluation; recorded hashes identify source artifacts only.

coverage.overflow_applicability: Finite-input overflow is exercised for BF16; FP16 checks finite-range preservation because four finite FP16 products cannot overflow finite FP32 C.

native_api_guard.source_inspection_observation: The baseline revision checks output compatibility but lacks a general enabled-format guard; this continuation adds the TFR guard.

gemm_common.reference: CPU double accumulation of converted input products
gemm_common.comparison: abs((actual-reference)/reference) < 0.01, with exact zero pairs accepted
